text:
Iris (Docs): Heads-up: Product wants a clean migration + deprecation note for v1.invoke -> v2.generate. Request: small one-pager, cURL/JS/Python snippets, support bullets, and a short ops checklist. Can we ship draft by Thursday?

Ben (API Eng): Yep. Main deltas: param rename `model_id` -> `model`, payload shape `input` -> `messages` (array of role/content), streaming event key `token` -> `delta`. We added a temporary header `X-Compat-Mode: v1` to preserve v1 behavior while customers migrate.

Iris (Docs): Can you paste minimal before/after cURL + a tiny shim we can show?

Ben (API Eng): Old v1 example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/invoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model_id":"rwd-lite","input":"Give me a TL;DR"}'
```
New v2 example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v2/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rwd-lite-2","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Give me a TL;DR"}]}'
```
Small server shim (JS) to keep legacy clients working:
```js
function legacyToV2(body){
  if(body.model_id){
    return { model: body.model_id.replace(/-lite$/, '-lite-2'), messages:[{role:'user', content: body.input||''}] }
  }
  return body
}
```
Iris (Docs): Nice. Can we add a Python snippet too for migration guide?

Ben (API Eng): Simple Python requests sample for v2:
```py
import requests
resp = requests.post('https://api.redwood.com/v2/generate', headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+KEY,'Content-Type':'application/json'}, json={'model':'rwd-lite-2','messages':[{'role':'user','content':'Hello'}]})
print(resp.json())
```

Sofia (SE): For Dedicated/private customers: call out firewall path change (/v2/*) and that some on-prem routing may need an update. Recommend canary routing (10% -> 50% -> 100%) and include a sample HAProxy rule snippet in the doc. Also note we will keep a 307 redirect for GETs during Stage 2; POSTs will only be allowed with `X-Compat-Mode: v1` during transition.

Iris (Docs): Good. Support wants a short triage flow — Harper, can you paste quick bullets?

Harper (Support): Sure. Triage bullets: 1) If customer sees 410 on POST — ask if they're on an old SDK or private deployment; 2) Advise temporary header: `X-Compat-Mode: v1`; 3) Escalate if high-volume customer, offer migration help call; 4) If streaming differences are blocking, explain v2 delta shape and offer to enable compat header for 2 weeks. I'll craft canned replies once doc draft lands.

Iris (Docs): Security/ops note: will the compat header be logged?

Ben (API Eng): Yes it will appear in request metadata. Ops retention is 30 days. We'll add privacy blurb: header values may be retained up to 30 days; contact security@redwood.com for access/redaction.

Iris (Docs): Timeline: Draft by Thu morning, reviews Thu afternoon (eng/se/support/ops), publish Fri AM with soft in-app banner then public blog 48h later. Ben, can you open the SDK changelog PR with the param rename examples?

Ben (API Eng): Opening now — will paste link when ready. Also note: compatibility shim adds ~5-10ms per request; mention in docs under "Performance impact".

LogBot: docs PR created -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3120 (v1-to-v2-migration-draft)

Iris (Docs): Thanks. I'll include a short migration checklist at the top: 1) upgrade SDK or add shim, 2) test messages payload, 3) validate streaming clients, 4) update firewall/routing, 5) remove compat header after migration window.

Harper (Support): One more: add a quick diagnostic curl to check server response headers so support can see if compat mode is enabled: `curl -I -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v2/generate -H "X-Compat-Mode: v1"`

Sofia (SE): I'll drop a canary routing HAProxy snippet in this thread by EOD and a short note for Dedicated customers about SSL passthrough caveats.

Iris (Docs): Perfect. If no blockers I will merge after reviews and coordinate with product for the announcement. :thumbsup:
